responsibility: Declares the internal data model and debugging interface for GCC’s constraint-based tree points-to analysis in the pointer_analysis namespace. This header defines the core constraint language used by tree-ssa-structalias.cc—constraint_expr and constraint records for scalar, dereference, and address-of relations; the variable_info structure that owns per-node field/offset, heap/global/restrict/IPA classification, associated tree decls, and points-to solution bitmaps; special abstract variable IDs such as anything, escaped, nonlocal, and integer; global solver state vectors like varmap, constraints, and var_rep; and dump/debug helpers and offset-to-subvariable lookup routines used by the solver implementation rather than by the outward-facing alias API in tree-ssa-alias.h.
same_name_distinction: This is the internal declaration header for the tree-ssa-structalias implementation: it defines the shared constraint/variable types, special variable IDs, global solver-state declarations, and dump/debug entry points consumed by gcc/tree-ssa-structalias.cc. Unlike the .cc peer, it does not build or solve points-to constraints or run the IPA PTA pass; it exposes the analyzer’s internal data model to that implementation and related code.
